entities.name: N-Debenzylation
observations: The reactant contains an N-benzyl substituent on a cyclic amine; the product is the corresponding secondary amine with the ring and side chain retained.
The matched empirical record supports catalytic hydrogenolysis using H2 in methanol.

entities.name: H2/Pd-C in methanol
observations: Most likely reagent system for the observed N-debenzylation is hydrogen gas with palladium on carbon in methanol.

entities.name: Transfer hydrogenation alternatives
observations: Chemically plausible alternatives include Pd/C with ammonium formate or 1,4-cyclohexadiene, but these are not directly evidenced for this record.
